name: Jiratice (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a white upper hoist part bearing a grey scythe blade and a grey square with a hook, and a navy blue lower fly part bearing a yellow bucket pouring white water.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 19 January 2007 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
